svg.text: Where the artifact comes first — and the wait that does not differ
Every (model, paper) pair by the months between them, one row per field. One dot is one pair.
months between the paper and the model that cites it
pooled median once the paper is first: 21 months
Black ticks are each field's median once the paper comes first. They land within four months of each other and of the pooled line — that is the null.
The field difference is the orange mass left of zero — the model created BEFORE the paper it cites, so the paper documents what already shipped.
This replaces a scatter whose two axes were the same distribution counted twice (r = -0.86), and which reported a 2.5x field speed difference that decoupling removes.
Top-1,000-by-download listing, so this is the wait among models that succeeded. Agents and RL have no pipeline_tag and sit inside LLM-core.
1.9% of pairs run past 84 months and are drawn pinned at the right edge.
